finding.trigger: With existing allow-tools and auto-execute enabled, discover/reveal the actual SceneTreeEditor Tree, select an editable scene node and route edit_tree_cell for column 0.
finding.actual: The new generic Tree edit advertises only confirmation_required. Existing host auto-execute calls _confirm_action, native Tree::edit_cell emits item_edited, and SceneTreeEditor::_edited renames the actual selected scene node without fresh human approval.
finding.expected: The scene-edit confirmation boundary already imposed by scene_rename_node must also apply when a declared Tree cell action reaches the same scene mutation.
finding.scope: SceneTreeEditor ancestor context; this does not justify forcing unrelated ordinary Tree controls to require fresh human approval.
finding.recommended_correction: Mark writes under actual native SceneTreeEditor ancestors manual_confirmation_required and preserve that flag through compound forwarding. Bind actual scene root/editor-selection/history context to the preview and revalidate it after approval, in addition to TreeItem/column state.

native_evidence.setup: Self-contained cloned editor and private project, native Node2D scene with a selected Victim child; native allow-tools/auto-execute configured only in the private editor.
native_evidence.discovery: Actual normal automatic capability target matched the native Tree instance. No alias metadata or custom callback was injected. Initial hidden target explicitly rejected target_not_visible; existing semantic open_target and main_screen 2D then made the ordinary native editor view available.
native_evidence.interpretation: Although the request correctly does not claim downstream business completion, actual native scene mutation was observed; business_completed:false does not preserve the human-approval boundary.

static_trace.evidence: _update_node makes column 0 editable when can_rename; metadata is a relative NodePath; item_edited is connected to _edited; _edited resolves selected row against current edited scene and calls rename_node.
metadata_identity supports NodePath. New edit_tree_cell branch accepts visible editable Tree rows, snapshots content and target instance, then requests confirmation without a manual-only marker.
Existing auto_execute_commands path auto-confirms results lacking manual_confirmation_required.
Dedicated scene mutations already return manual_confirmation_required=true.

context_fence_assessment: Tree state currently binds TreeItem identity/content/metadata/selection and column configuration, but lacks actual scene root, SceneTreeEditor identity, actual editor selection and scene/history fence. A context-specific fence is needed to prevent an old visible row snapshot from being treated as authorization for a changed native scene/history context; this additional drift scenario was statically assessed, not independently runtime reproduced.
limits: Only private headless editor state was modified. No production editor, original Issue483 project, owner, queue, history or user application was opened or changed.
No human approval was simulated or emitted in the successful bypass probe. Permission switches were only private fixture setup, not an authorization claim for production.
The scene/history drift concern remains a source-level assessment; the direct no-human rename is actual native HTTP runtime evidence.
Prior no-blocking-finding review conclusion is superseded for this newly reproduced SceneTreeEditor Tree-edit path; no earlier immutable report has been overwritten.
Repair, negative revalidation and unrelated ordinary-Tree auto-execute regression require their own subsequent evidence.
